Read a taxonomy file

Source: R/taxonomy.R
read_taxonomy.Rd

Reads a file that gives the taxonomy (lineage) of each sequence and returns it as a standard lineage table. Three layouts are recognized automatically:

Usage

read_taxonomy(file, format = c("auto", "taxonomizr", "lineage", "table"))

Arguments

file

Path to the taxonomy file.

format

`"auto"` (default), `"taxonomizr"`, `"lineage"` or `"table"`.

Value

A lineage table: a data frame with columns `id`, `taxid` and the seven ranks returned by [taxonomic_ranks()]; missing values are `NA`.

Details

* **taxonomizr / MetaCurator input format** (also written by [write_results()]): comma-separated, no header, columns `taxid`, `accession`, `taxid`, then domain, phylum, class, order, family, genus and species. Example: `"49992","Z37472.1","49992","Eukaryota","Streptophyta",NA,"Lamiales",...` * **lineage strings** (QIIME, Metaxa2 and similar): two tab-separated columns, the ID and a `;`-separated lineage, optionally with rank prefixes such as `k__`, `d__`, `p__`, `c__`, `o__`, `f__`, `g__`, `s__`. * **a table with a header row** (tab- or comma-separated) with an ID column (`id`, `accession`, `seqid` or `qseqid`) and columns named after ranks (`superkingdom`/`kingdom`/`domain`, `phylum`, ..., `species`).

Examples

f <- system.file("extdata", "taxonomy.tax", package = "metacleaner")
tax <- read_taxonomy(f)
head(tax)
#>           id   taxid    domain       phylum         class     order     family
#> 1 MZ509216.1  109224 Eukaryota Streptophyta Magnoliopsida   Fabales   Fabaceae
#> 2 MZ509176.1 2909194 Eukaryota Streptophyta Magnoliopsida   Fabales   Fabaceae
#> 3 MW545606.1  463586 Eukaryota Streptophyta Magnoliopsida Asterales Asteraceae
#> 4 MW545649.1  463591 Eukaryota Streptophyta Magnoliopsida Asterales Asteraceae
#> 5 MW545773.1  401928 Eukaryota Streptophyta Magnoliopsida Asterales Asteraceae
#> 6 MW545611.1 2068728 Eukaryota Streptophyta Magnoliopsida Asterales Asteraceae
#>           genus                  species
#> 1   Neustanthus Neustanthus phaseoloides
#> 2      Pueraria        Pueraria sp. KK8s
#> 3        Ajania         Ajania potaninii
#> 4 Chrysanthemum  Chrysanthemum zawadzkii
#> 5     Artemisia      Artemisia pubescens
#> 6        Ajania     Ajania scharnhorstii
